summary.text: Christina Morales is a Democratic state representative who has represented Texas House District 145 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Christina Morales took office in the Texas House in 2019.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Inocensia Moreno is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
